git_github_add_remote: Button of the Pull request tab, and title of the dialog it opens, that adds a git remote.
git_github_add_remote_body: Body of the dialog that adds a git remote.
git_github_add_remote_confirm: Confirm button of the dialog that adds a git remote.
git_github_auto_merge_enabled: Success toast after enabling auto-merge on a pull request.

git_github_check_cancelled.description: State chip of one check. Raw value CANCELLED of gh pr checks.
git_github_check_cancelled.distinct: a check (masculine); the other is a task (feminine)

git_github_check_error: State chip of one check. Raw value ERROR of gh pr checks.
git_github_check_failure: State chip of one check. Raw value FAILURE of gh pr checks.
git_github_check_in_progress: State chip of one check. Raw value IN_PROGRESS of gh pr checks.
git_github_check_neutral: State chip of one check. Raw value NEUTRAL of gh pr checks.
git_github_check_pending: State chip of one check. Raw value PENDING of gh pr checks.
git_github_check_queued: State chip of one check. Raw value QUEUED of gh pr checks.
git_github_check_skipped: State chip of one check. Raw value SKIPPED of gh pr checks.
git_github_check_success: State chip of one check. Raw value SUCCESS of gh pr checks.
git_github_check_timed_out: State chip of one check. Raw value TIMED_OUT of gh pr checks.
git_github_checks_chip_failed: Chip of a pull request whose checks failed.
git_github_checks_chip_ok: Chip of a pull request whose checks all passed.
git_github_checks_chip_pending: Chip of a pull request whose checks are still running.
git_github_checks_title: Heading of the checks list in the Pull request tab.
git_github_cli_missing_body: Body of the Pull request tab when gh is missing.
git_github_cli_missing_title: Title of the Pull request tab when gh is missing.
git_github_command_failed: Error toast for any other gh failure; the Details action shows gh's own output.
git_github_commented: Success toast after commenting on a pull request.
git_github_create_branch: Button of the Pull request tab on the default branch: opens the branch picker.
git_github_create_failed: Error toast when `gh pr create` failed; the Details action shows gh's own output.
git_github_created: Success toast after creating a pull request.
git_github_default_branch_body: Body of the Pull request tab on the default branch.
git_github_default_branch_title: Title of the Pull request tab when the checked out branch is the default branch.
git_github_error_title: Title of the Pull request tab when gh failed. The body is gh's own message.
git_github_marked_ready: Success toast after a draft pull request was marked ready for review.
git_github_merge_commit: Merge menu item of the Pull request tab.
git_github_merge_rebase: Merge menu item of the Pull request tab.
git_github_merge_squash: Merge menu item of the Pull request tab.
git_github_merged: Success toast after a pull request was merged.
git_github_no_commits_body: Body of the Pull request tab when the repository has no commit.
git_github_no_commits_title: Title of the Pull request tab when the repository has no commit.
git_github_no_remote_body: Body of the Pull request tab when no remote exists.
git_github_no_remote_title: Title of the Pull request tab when no remote exists.
git_github_not_github_body: Body of the Pull request tab when a remote is not GitHub and none is named.
git_github_not_github_body_remote: Body of the Pull request tab when a remote is not GitHub. {name} is the remote's name, {url} its address.
git_github_not_github_title: Title of the Pull request tab when the remotes point to another forge.
git_github_not_pushed_body: Body of the Pull request tab when the branch has no upstream. {remote} is the remote's name.
git_github_not_pushed_title: Title of the Pull request tab when the branch has no upstream.
git_github_pr_closed: Status chip of a pull request that was closed without merge. Raw value CLOSED of gh.
git_github_pr_draft: Status chip of a draft pull request.

git_github_pr_merged.description: Status chip of a pull request that was merged. Raw value MERGED of gh.
git_github_pr_merged.distinct: the state chip of a pull request; the other is the success toast of the merge action

git_github_pr_open.description: Status chip of a pull request that is open.
git_github_pr_open.distinct: a status word on a chip, not the Open action

git_github_push_branch: Button of the Pull request tab that pushes the branch and sets its upstream.
git_github_pushed: Success toast after the Pull request tab pushed a branch.
git_github_ready_body: Body of the Pull request tab when the branch has no pull request.
git_github_ready_title: Title of the Pull request tab when the branch is pushed and has no pull request.
git_github_review_approved: Chip of a pull request review decision. Raw value APPROVED of gh.
git_github_review_changes: Chip of a pull request review decision. Raw value CHANGES_REQUESTED of gh.

git_github_review_commented.description: Tag of a review in the pull request timeline. Raw value COMMENTED of gh.
git_github_review_commented.distinct: a review tag in the timeline; the other is the success toast after commenting

git_github_review_dismissed: Tag of a review in the pull request timeline. Raw value DISMISSED of gh.
git_github_review_required: Chip of a pull request review decision. Raw value REVIEW_REQUIRED of gh.

git_github_rollup_failed.description: Word next to the Checks heading: at least one check failed.
git_github_rollup_failed.distinct: summarizes several checks, so 'com falha' agrees with any number; 'falhou' is one thing's outcome

git_github_rollup_ok: Word next to the Checks heading: all checks passed.

git_github_rollup_pending.description: Word next to the Checks heading: checks are still running.
git_github_rollup_pending.distinct: summarizes several checks (plural); the other is one check

git_github_sign_in: Title and button of the Pull request tab when gh is signed out.
git_github_signed_out_body: Body of the Pull request tab when gh is signed out.
